instruction: A candid cinematic still, full shot at eye-level, captures a sunny outdoor grassy courtyard with a rustic yellow stucco building in the background. On the left, the man in the khaki blazer and shorts (R1) stands with his back to the camera, raising his right arm. On the right, the woman in the beige midi dress (R2) faces forward-left, looking up at him. The man (R1) holds the woman's (R2) left hand high above her head with his right hand, guiding her in a playful dance spin on the green lawn. Bright, warm afternoon sunlight casts long, distinct shadows across the grass, creating a cheerful, romantic atmosphere.
